news.title: Flamingos Get Very Strong Tip To Excel At 2026 FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: Nigeria’s cadet female national team, Flamingos have received a very strong tip to excel next month at the 2026 FIFA Women’s U17 World Cup, based on their amazing form at West African Football Union (WAFU)-B competition in Cote d’Ivoire. READ ALSO: Flamingos Fly To Glory! Nigeria Sweep WAFU-B U17 Girls Cup With Five Straight Wins. Sports247 reports that Coach Hakeem Busari’s side ended the competition with a 4-0 trouncing of Togo to complete a clean sweep of five straight victories that gave them top spot on the round robin table, much to the delight of Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) officials.

news.title: England 2-3 Spain: Anthony Gordon and Roy Keane disagree over gap between Three Lions and world champions
news.lede: Roy Keane disagreed with Anthony Gordon's assessment that England are at the same level as Spain after the World Cup winners came from behind to beat Thomas Tuchel's side 3-2 in their Nations League opener. Spain extend their unbeaten run to 39 games with the win at Wembley, but the game could have had a very different outcome had Harry Kane not missed a second-half penalty after he headed England 2-1 in front before the break. The momentum shifted in Spain's favour after Kane's slip, with Alex Baena equalising off the bench before setting up the winner, scored by fellow substitute Mikel Oyarzabal, who broke England hearts in the Euro 2024 final. "I don't think there is a gap [to Spain] I feel like we're right there," Gordon told ITV Sport .

news.title: Footgolf and the Jabulani: a second life for ‘the worst ball I’ve seen in my life’
news.lede: The infamous Jabulani, created for the 2010 World Cup, is now footgolf’s ball of choice and going for upwards of £500. About once a month, Ben Clarke, the world’s leading footgolfer, carefully pumps up his collection of coveted Adidas Jabulani footballs. Like most elite players, Clarke possesses an extensive array of balls, all of which require regular inflation to prevent degradation, even those sitting pristine in their original boxes, unsullied by a single boot. Footballs are prime currency in a niche sport that tasks players with kicking one around a course, and into 18 oversized holes, in as few strokes as possible.

news.title: 2030 World Cup Final: The Rivalry Between Spain and Morocco
news.lede: In the world of futsal and football, intense debates continue regarding the hosting of the 2030 World Cup. Although the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) has awarded the right to host this prestigious tournament to a joint bid from three countries—Spain, Portugal, and Morocco—the question of which nation will host the most important match, the final, is causing serious controversy. Currently, a unique hidden rivalry is brewing between Madrid and Rabat. This is reported by Goal.com reports .

news.title: Is Spain more deserving than Morocco to host the 2030 World Cup final? The facts prove otherwise
news.lede: The growing racism seen in Spain's stadiums lately reopens the hot-button issue. A tug of war has broken out over who hosts the 2030 World Cup final between Spain and Morocco. The European nation insists the trophy must be lifted on its soil. Morocco, meanwhile, pitches itself as the stronger option on readiness, infrastructure and the image FIFA wants the tournament to carry.
